text: Keep the hook-off flag in .git or move it to .bowman/runtime?

status.comment: Question for Felix: the flag is .git/aimparency-continue-disabled (per clone, never committed). .bowman/runtime/ is also gitignored and holds the other machine-local state, so it would be easier to find. Move it there (hook script + shared/continue-hook, legacy flag still honored), or keep it?
